title: A benediction addressed to a newly elected King

verses.t: Here art thou: I have chosen thee. Stand stedfast and immovable. Let all the clans desire thee: let not thy kingdom fall away.
Be even here: fall not away: be like a mountain unremoved. Stand stedfast here like Indra's self, and hold the kingship in the grasp.
This man hath Indra stablished, made secure by constant sacrifice. Soma, and Brāhmanaspati here present bless and comfort him!
